name: AC Minimum
description: Sets a floor under the wearer's own AC, without replacing the normal calculation the way a fixed AC would.

mechanics.text: While active, the wearer's own AC can't be less than featureParams.minimum, regardless of armor worn — other bonuses (a shield, a spell) can still raise it above that floor. Distinct from feat.set-ac (replaces the AC calculation outright) and feat.protection-bonus (an additive bonus, no floor concept at all).
